title: Meet Bizzy Bea the Bee
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Meet Bizzy Bea the Bee! Buzz, buzz!
Bea is a honeybee. She lives in a hive.
Her hive has lots and lots of sisters.
The mom of the hive is the queen. She lays all the eggs.
Bea flies to the flowers. She sips sweet nectar.
Yellow pollen sticks to her fuzzy legs.
Now it looks like Bea has on yellow pants!
Back home, Bea does a wiggle dance.
The dance says, "Flowers are that way!"
The bees make honey from the nectar.
Birds like to eat bees. A bear wants the honey!
Bea can sting to keep the hive safe. But she would rather dance.

o: To show where the flowers are
